round, turn_index FROM combat_sessions WHERE id = \" + quote(id) + \";\");\n            if (sessionRows.isEmpty()) return null;\n            Map<String, Object> sessionRow = sessionRows.get(0);\n\n            List<Combatant> combatants = new ArrayList<>();\n            List<Map<String, Object>> combatantRows = query(\"SELECT name, score, dex, roll FROM combatants WHERE session_id = \" + quote(id) + \" ORDER BY sort_order;\");\n            for (Map<String, Object> row : combatantRows) {\n                combatants.add(new Combatant((String) row.get(\"name\"), JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"score\")), JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"dex\")), JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"roll\"))));\n            }\n\n            CombatSession session = new CombatSession((String) sessionRow.get(\"id\"), combatants);\n            session.round = JsonUtils.toInt(sessionRow.get(\"round\"));\n            session.turnIndex = JsonUtils.toInt(sessionRow.get(\"turn_index\"));\n\n            List<Map<String, Object>> conditionRows = query(\"SELECT target, condition, remaining_rounds FROM conditions WHERE session_id = \" + quote(id) + \" ORDER BY id;\");\n            for (Map<String, Object> row : conditionRows) {\n                String target = (String) row.get(\"target\");\n                session.conditions.computeIfAbsent(target, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(new Condition((String) row.get(\"condition\"), JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"remaining_rounds\"))));\n            }\n\n            return session;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public void addCondition(String sessionId, String target, String condition, int sqls.add(\"INSERT INTO combat_sessions (id, round, turn_index) VALUES (\" + quote(session.id) + \", \" + session.round + \", \" + session.turnIndex + \");\");\n            for (int i = 0; i < executeInsert(sqls);\n        }\n    }\n\n    public CombatSession getCombatSession(String id) {\n        synchronized (lock) {\n            List<Map<String, Object>> sessionRows = query(\"SELECT id, round, turn_index FROM combat_sessions WHERE id = \" + quote(id) + \";\");\n            if (sessionRows.isEmpty()) return null;\n            Map<String, Object> sessionRow = sessionRows.get(0);\n\n            List<Combatant> combatants = new ArrayList<>();\n            List<Map<String, Object>> combatantRows = query(\"SELECT name, score, dex, roll FROM combatants WHERE session_id = \" + quote(id) + \" ORDER BY sort_order;\");\n            for (Map<String, Object> row : combatantRows) {\n                combatants.add(new Combatant((String) row.get(\"name\"), JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"score\")), JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"dex\")), JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"roll\"))));\n            }\n\n            CombatSession session = new CombatSession((String) sessionRow.get(\"id\"), combatants);\n            session.round = JsonUtils.toInt(sessionRow.get(\"round\"));\n            session.turnIndex = JsonUtils.toInt(sessionRow.get(\"turn_index\"));\n\n            List<Map<String, Object>> conditionRows = query(\"SELECT target, condition, remaining_rounds FROM conditions WHERE session_id = \" + quote(id) + \" ORDER BY id;\");\n            for (Map<String, Object> row : conditionRows) {\n                String target = (String) row.get(\"target\");\n                session.conditions.computeIfAbsent(target, k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(new Condition((String) row.get(\"condition\"), JsonUtils.toInt(row.get(\"remaining_rounds\"))));\n            }\n\n            return session;\n        }\n    }\n\n    public void addCondition(String sessionId, String target, String condition, int List<String> sqls = new ArrayList<>();\n            sqls.add(\"BEGIN;\");\n            sqls.add(\"UPDATE combat_sessions SET round = \" + session.round + \", turn_index = \" + session.turnIndex + \" WHERE id = \" + quote(session.id) + \";\");\n            sqls.add(\"UPDATE conditions SET remaining_rounds = remaining_rounds - 1 WHERE session_id = \" + quote(session.id) + \" AND target = \" + quote(active.name) + \";\");\n            sqls.add(\"DELETE FROM conditions WHERE session_id = \" + quote(session.id) + \" AND target = \" + quote(active.name) + \" AND remaining_rounds <= 0;\");\n D&D Helper API — Codebase Guide\n\nThis is a small, deterministic HTTP API for D&D 5e style helpers.\nIt runs on OpenJDK with only the Java standard library and uses an external `sqlite3` binary for persistence.\n\n## Quick start\n\n```bash\nPORT=8080 ./run.sh\n```\n\n`run.sh` compiles the Java sources under `dnd/` and runs `dnd.Main` in the foreground.\nThe server listens on `127.0.0.1` and honors the `PORT` environment variable (default `8080`).\n\nVerify it is up:\n\n```bash\ncurl http://127.0.0.1:8080/health\n# -> {\"ok\":true}\n```\n\nStop the server with `Ctrl-C`.\n\n## Entry point and major files\n\n```\ndnd/\n  Main.java                 # entry point: opens the HTTP socket and wires the router\n  handlers/\n    RequestRouter.java      # registers all HTTP contexts; delegates to domain handlers\n    BaseHandler.java        # shared response helpers, error constants, authentication\n    CoreHandler.java        # health, dice stats, checks, encounter math, initiative, character rules\n    CombatHandler.java      # persisted combat sessions\n    AuthHandler.java        # user registration and login (PBKDF2 hashing)\n    StorageHandler.java     # storage status and reset\n    CompendiumHandler.java  # monster and item compendium entries\n    CampaignHandler.java    # campaigns: characters, events, quests, factions, NPCs, inventory,\n                            # open-thread derivation\n  json/\n    JsonParser.java         # minimal recursive-descent JSON parser\n    JsonUtils.java          # JSON serialization and int coercion\n  model/\n    Combatant.java          # initiative combatant\n    CombatSession.java      # persisted encounter\n    Condition.java          # status condition on a combatant\n    User.java               # registered user with salt/hash\n  storage/\n    Storage.java            # SQLite-backed persistence layer\n```\n\n`run.sh` compiles everything with `javac -d .` and then runs `java dnd.Main`.\n\n## State, persistence, and routing design\n\n### Persistence\n\nAll durable state lives in `game.db`, a SQLite database.\n`Storage` shells out to the `sqlite3` binary for each query and wraps every public method with a single `synchronized` lock, because each query is an independent process.\nThe schema is created lazily by `Storage.init()` and recreated by `Storage.reset()`.\n\nCommon persistence helpers live in `Storage` as private methods:\n- `executeInsert(...)` runs a write transaction and maps `UNIQUE` constraint failures to `false` so callers can return `409`.\n- `queryCount(...)` simplifies `SELECT COUNT(*) AS c` reads.\n- `quote(...)` escapes single quotes for SQLite string literals.\n\nTables:\n- `users` — registered accounts with PBKDF2 hash and salt.\n- `combat_sessions`, `combatants`, `conditions` — initiative and condition tracking.\n- `monsters`, `monster_tags` — monster compendium.\n- `items` — item compendium.\n- `campaigns`, `campaign_characters`, `campaign_events`, `quests`, `quest_milestones` — campaign state, session log, and quest tracker.\n- `factions`, `npcs` — campaign factions and NPCs with relationship disposition.\n- `sessions`, `session_attendance` — scheduled campaign sessions and per-character attendance.\n- `play_campaigns` — protected play-surface campaigns owned by a `dm` user.\n- `play_campaign_members` — player memberships in a play campaign, with one row per `(campaign_id, username)` and unique `character_id` per campaign.\n- `play_campaign_narrations` — append-only narration/action/resolution events for play campaigns.\n\n### Routing\n\n`Main` creates an `HttpServer` from `com.sun.net.httpserver`, builds a `RequestRouter`, and calls `router.register(server)` to attach all contexts.\n`RequestRouter` does not implement request logic itself; it instantiates domain handlers and wires contexts to handler methods.\n\nShared handler infrastructure lives in `BaseHandler`:\n- `requireMethod`, `badRequest`, `notFound`, `unauthorized`, `forbidden`\n- exact JSON error-body constants\n- `authenticate` — validates `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>` and supports deterministic fixture tokens even after a storage reset.\n\nHandlers are grouped by domain and file:\n\n- **Core:** `/health`, `/v1/dice/stats`, `/v1/checks/ability`, `/v1/encounters/adjusted-xp`, `/v1/initiative/order`, `/v1/characters/*`\n- **Combat:** `/v1/combat/sessions`, `/v1/combat/sessions/{id}/conditions`, `/v1/combat/sessions/{id}/advance`\n- **Auth:** `/v1/auth/register`, `/v1/auth/login`\n- **Storage:** `/v1/storage/status`, `/v1/storage/reset`\n- **Compendium:** `/v1/compendium/monsters`, `/v1/compendium/monsters/{slug}`, `/v1/compendium/items`, `/v1/compendium/items/{slug}`\n- **Campaigns:** `/v1/campaigns`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/downtime/crafting`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/downtime/crafting/{project_id}/advance`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/sessions`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/sessions/next`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/sessions/{session_id}/attendance`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/analytics/*`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/export`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/audit`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/quests/{quest_id}/progress`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/quests/summary`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/inventory`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/inventory/summary`, `/v1/campaigns/{id}/characters/{character_id}/equipment`\n- **PHB rules:** `/v1/phb/spell-slots`, `/v1/phb/rests/long`, `/v1/phb/equipment-load`\n- **DM tools:** `/v1/dm/encounter-builder`, `/v1/dm/loot-parcel`, `/v1/dm/session-recap`\n- **Play campaigns:** `/v1/play/campaigns`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/members`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/start`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/narrations`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/actions`, `/v1/play/campaigns/{id}/document`\n\nMost handlers validate the request body, throw `RuntimeException` on bad input, and translate any exception into a `400` response. Missing resources return `404`. Conflicts return `409`.\n\n### JSON handling\n\nRequests and responses are JSON. The built-in `JsonParser` and `JsonUtils` are intentionally minimal and preserve the exact output format expected by the test suite:\n\n- Field order is determined by `LinkedHashMap` insertion order.\n- Numbers without a fractional part are serialized as integers.\n- Only standard escape sequences are supported.\n\nIf you change serialization, ensure the test suite output format stays identical.\n\n## Main API / domain groupings\n\n### Initiative and combat\n\n- `POST /v1/initiative/order` — sorts combatants by `roll + dex`, breaking ties by dex then name.\n- `POST /v1/combat/sessions` — creates a persisted combat session with a sorted order and returns the first active combatant.\n- `POST /v1/combat/sessions/{id}/conditions` — adds a timed condition to a combatant in the session.\n- `POST /v1/combat/sessions/{id}/advance` — advances the turn tracker, increments the round on wrap, and decrements/removes conditions on the newly active combatant.\n\n### Encounter math\n\n- `POST /v1/encounters/adjusted-xp` — calculates base XP, multiplier, adjusted XP, and difficulty thresholds for a party.\n- `POST /v1/dm/encounter-builder` — looks up monster slugs from the compendium and delegates to the same encounter math.\n\n### Compendium and campaigns\n\n- Monsters and items are created by slug and read back by slug.\n- Campaigns own characters and a For an active campaign, the queue is built by alternating each party member (in the deterministic party order) with the DM — for example, a two-player party yields `[\"player-a\",\"dm\",\"player-b\",\"dm\"]`. Returns the created campaign with `owner`, `status: \"lobby\"`, and `max_players`.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/members` lets an authenticated player join a lobby campaign. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only `player` users may join. Body `{\"character_id\":\"...\",\"name\":\"...\",\"class\":\"...\"}`. Returns 201 with `username`, `character_id`, `name`, and `class`. A player may own at most one membership per campaign, character IDs must be unique within the campaign, and the party cannot exceed `max_players`; any of those conflicts returns 409.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/start` starts a lobby campaign. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only the campaign owner (a `dm` user) may start. A lobby campaign with at least two party members becomes `active` exactly once and returns `{\"id\":\"...\",\"status\":\"active\",\"current_actor\":\"...\",\"turn_number\":1}`, where `current_actor` is the alphabetically first party member. Returns 403 for non-owners or players, 404 if the campaign does not exist, and 409 if the campaign is already active or has fewer than two members.\n- `GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/turn` reads the current turn. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only the campaign owner or a party member may read. Returns the campaign's `current_actor`, `phase` (`lobby`, `dm`, or `player`), `turn_number`, a deterministic `queue`, plus deterministic timeout metadata: `overdue` (`false` for a fresh turn) and a logical integer `logical_deadline`. For an active campaign, the queue is built by alternating each party member (in the deterministic party order) with the DM — for example, a two-player party yields `[\"player-a\",\"dm\",\"player-b\",\"dm\"]`. Lobby campaigns return an empty queue. The deadline is a logical integer derived from the turn number; wall-clock time is not used.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/turn/nudge` lets the campaign owner send a nonempty reminder message to the current actor. Returns `{\"is_my_turn\":bool,\"current_actor\":\"...\",\"character\":{\"id\":\"...\",\"name\":\"...\"},\"recent_events\":[...]}`. The player only sees their own character (id and name) and the public play-campaign narration events; no DM-private fields are exposed.\n- `GET /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/gm/status` returns the owner-only GM turn context. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only the campaign owner (a `dm` user) may read. Players receive 403. Returns `{\"needs_attention\":bool,\"current_actor\":\"...\",\"party\":[...],\"recent_events\":[...]}`. `needs_attention` is `true` exactly when the current actor is the owner. `party` is a summary of all party members (`username`, `character_id`, `name`, `class`). `recent_events` are the public play-campaign narration events.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/narrations` appends a DM narration event. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only the campaign owner (a `dm` user) may narrate. Body `{\"text\":\"...\"}`. Returns 201 with the ordered event `{\"sequence\":1,\"kind\":\"narration\",\"actor\":\"dm\",\"text\":\"...\"}`. Sequence starts at 1 for each campaign and is append-only. Players receive 403.\n- `POST /v1/play/campaigns/{id}/actions` lets the active party player submit an action. Requires `Authorization: Bearer session-<username>`; only the player whose username matches the campaign's `current_actor` may submit. Body `{\"type\":\"...\",\"text\":\"...\"}`. Returns 201 with the ordered event `{\"sequence\":1,\"kind\":\"action\",\"actor\":\"...\",\"type\":\"...\",\"text\":\"...\",\"next_actor\":\"dm\"}`, advances the campaign's `current_actor` to the DM, and increments the turn number.
